name: create_waitlist
description: Create a new waitlist on your Waitlister account (requires an account key, works on every plan within its waitlist cap). Returns the waitlist key and a form_action_url that collects signups immediately. Pass landing_page to also provision the hosted landing page (as a draft — go live with publish_landing_page) in the same call. Note: waitlist names and URL slugs are unique across all of Waitlister — a taken name/slug is rejected with guidance to pick another.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The product/waitlist name

arguments.name: slug
arguments.desc: URL slug (derived from name when omitted; must be globally unique)

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Internal description

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Product category

arguments.name: referral_rewards_enabled
arguments.desc: Enable the referral program (points for signups and referrals)

arguments.name: validate_emails
arguments.desc: Validate email deliverability at signup (default true)

arguments.name: landing_page
arguments.desc: Also create the hosted landing page (draft) in the same request. headline required. More fields (background, SEO) via update_landing_page afterwards.

name: get_account
description: Check the configured API key and what this account may do — the cheapest first call, and the one to make when anything looks misconfigured. Returns the account, the plan name, whether the general API is available, how many waitlists the account has against its cap, whether creating another would succeed right now (can_create — a true dry run, so check it before create_waitlist rather than discovering the cap from an error), remaining AI credits, and the key's name/created/last-used. An invalid or revoked key fails here cleanly, which distinguishes a dead key from a malformed request. Requires an account key (wl_acct_…) and works on every plan. Never returns the key itself.

name: list_waitlists
description: List every waitlist your account owns, with subscriber and view counts (requires an account key).

name: get_stats
description: Get a waitlist's subscriber and view counters. Works on every plan. Counters update asynchronously (within seconds of a signup or delete).

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: add_subscriber
description: Add a new subscriber to a waitlist. Returns their position, referral code, and sign-up token. Idempotent per email: an existing email returns is_new_sign_up: false with their current position, not an error. If the waitlist uses double opt-in or welcome emails, the subscriber is emailed, exactly as with a form signup. Works on every plan.

arguments.name: email
arguments.desc: The subscriber's email address

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: The subscriber's name

arguments.name: phone
arguments.desc: The subscriber's phone number

arguments.name: referred_by
arguments.desc: Referral code of the person who referred this subscriber

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.desc: Additional custom fields to store with the subscriber (e.g. company, role)

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: list_subscribers
description: Retrieve a paginated list of a waitlist's subscribers (each with its tags), sortable by position, points, date, referral_count, or email, and optionally filtered to one tag. Requires the Growth plan or higher.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Number of results to return (1-100, default 20)

arguments.name: page
arguments.desc: Page number for pagination (default 1)

arguments.name: sort_by
arguments.desc: Field to sort by (default: date)

arguments.name: sort_dir
arguments.desc: Sort direction (default: desc)

arguments.name: tag
arguments.desc: Only subscribers with this tag: a tag name (case-insensitive) or id. See list_tags

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: get_subscriber
description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific subscriber by their ID or email address — position, points, referral info, tags, metadata, location, and more. Requires the Growth plan or higher.

arguments.name: id_or_email
arguments.desc: The subscriber's unique ID or email address

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: update_subscriber
description: Update an existing subscriber's name, phone, points, custom metadata, and/or tags. Only include fields you want to change; updating points triggers a queue position recalculation. Tags are named case-insensitively (or by id): add_tags and remove_tags change some, tags replaces the whole set. A tag name the waitlist doesn't have yet is created, so call list_tags first and reuse an existing name rather than creating a near-duplicate. Requires the Growth plan or higher.

arguments.name: id_or_email
arguments.desc: The subscriber's unique ID or email address

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Updated name

arguments.name: phone
arguments.desc: Updated phone number

arguments.name: points
arguments.desc: Updated points value

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.desc: Custom fields to add or update (merged with existing metadata)

arguments.name: add_tags
arguments.desc: Tags to add, by name or id. New names create a tag (max 20 per waitlist, 30 characters each)

arguments.name: remove_tags
arguments.desc: Tags to remove, by name or id. Tags the subscriber doesn't have are ignored

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Replace the subscriber's tags with exactly this set ([] removes all). Not combinable with add_tags/remove_tags

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: delete_subscriber
description: Permanently delete a subscriber (and their email history) from a waitlist by ID or email address. This cannot be undone. Counters and queue positions update asynchronously within a few seconds. Requires the Growth plan or higher.

arguments.name: id_or_email
arguments.desc: The subscriber's unique ID or email address

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: list_tags
description: List a waitlist's subscriber tags (the dashboard's Tags column) and how many subscribers have each. Use these names with list_subscribers' tag filter and update_subscriber's add_tags/remove_tags. Requires the Growth plan or higher.

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: log_view
description: Record a view of a waitlist page — useful for tracking engagement and conversion rates when you host your own landing page.

arguments.name: visitor_id
arguments.desc: Unique identifier for the visitor (prevents duplicate counts)

arguments.name: referring_domain
arguments.desc: Domain that referred the view

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: get_landing_page
description: Get the structured view of a waitlist's hosted landing page: status (draft/published/unpublished), page_type (standard or ai), copy fields, theme, SEO, the live URL (null until published), and view/signup analytics. AI-built pages also return remaining AI credits. Works on every plan. 404 if the waitlist has no page yet — create one with create_landing_page.

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: create_landing_page
description: Create the waitlist's hosted landing page from structured fields, as a draft (nothing goes live until publish_landing_page). One page per waitlist — returns a 409 error if one already exists (use update_landing_page then). headline is required. Works on every plan. Tip: when creating a new waitlist AND its page, use create_waitlist's landing_page parameter instead — one call.

arguments.name: headline
arguments.desc: The page's main title (3-120 characters, plain text — no HTML)

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Supporting copy under the headline (max 1000 characters, plain text)

arguments.name: button_text
arguments.desc: Submit-button label (max 40 characters, default "Join the waitlist")

arguments.name: collect_name
arguments.desc: Add (true) or remove (false) a name input on the signup form

arguments.name: collect_phone
arguments.desc: Add (true) or remove (false) a phone input on the signup form

arguments.name: background
arguments.desc: Page background (image backgrounds are dashboard-only)

arguments.name: theme
arguments.desc: Page theme

arguments.name: seo
arguments.desc: Search/social metadata for the hosted page

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: update_landing_page
description: Update any subset of the landing page's structured fields. On a published page the change goes live immediately. IMPORTANT: on an AI-built page (page_type "ai"), the copy/structure fields (headline, description, button_text, collect_name, collect_phone, background) return a 409 error — edit those with generate_landing_page and is_edit: true; theme and seo still work here on both page types. Works on every plan.

arguments.name: headline
arguments.desc: The page's main title (3-120 characters, plain text — no HTML)

arguments.name: description
arguments.desc: Supporting copy under the headline (max 1000 characters, plain text)

arguments.name: button_text
arguments.desc: Submit-button label (max 40 characters, default "Join the waitlist")

arguments.name: collect_name
arguments.desc: Add (true) or remove (false) a name input on the signup form

arguments.name: collect_phone
arguments.desc: Add (true) or remove (false) a phone input on the signup form

arguments.name: background
arguments.desc: Page background (image backgrounds are dashboard-only)

arguments.name: theme
arguments.desc: Page theme

arguments.name: seo
arguments.desc: Search/social metadata for the hosted page

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: publish_landing_page
description: Publish the landing page to its live URL (https://waitlister.me/p/{slug}, or the waitlist's custom domain), making it publicly visible. Publishing validates the page has an email field, a submit button, and a headline of at least 3 characters. API publishes skip the custom social-share (OG) image; publishing once from the dashboard generates it. To take a page offline, use unpublish_landing_page. Works on every plan.

arguments.name: unpublish
arguments.desc: Removed in 1.5.0 — use unpublish_landing_page. Passing true is refused and changes nothing.

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: unpublish_landing_page
description: Take the published landing page offline (status becomes "unpublished"); its URL stops serving the page and stops collecting signups. The page and its subscribers are kept, and publish_landing_page brings it back. Works on every plan.

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.

name: generate_landing_page
description: Generate a complete custom landing page from a natural-language prompt with Waitlister's AI builder (same engine as the dashboard), or edit the existing AI page with is_edit: true. COSTS 1 AI CREDIT per call (shared with the dashboard AI builder; errors with the balance when out of credits) — don't call repeatedly for small tweaks a human should review. Synchronous, typically 20-50 seconds. The result is saved as a draft: review in the dashboard or go live with publish_landing_page. The AI conversation is saved, so the dashboard's AI chat continues where this left off. After generating, the page is an AI page — see update_landing_page for what that changes.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.desc: What to build or change, in natural language (e.g. "dark, bold, dev-tool aesthetic")

arguments.name: is_edit
arguments.desc: true edits the existing AI page instead of generating a fresh one (409 if there is no AI page yet)

arguments.name: waitlist_key
arguments.desc: The waitlist key (12 characters, from list_waitlists or the dashboard). Optional if WAITLISTER_WAITLIST_KEY is set.
